hypotheses.paper: cet espace fibré est topologiquement trivial
hypotheses.note: [T2Space B] [ParacompactSpace B] (or V second countable + B T2); B T2 is necessary (t2Space_of_section) and not derived from V T2

questions: Does V Hausdorff (with Déf. 2's 3°) force the base B = V/ℝ⁺ to be Hausdorff? Not proved here; sufficient: the ℝ₊* action is proper (t2Space_of_properSMul). It matters for Déf. 3's « topologiquement trivial » (a section forces B Hausdorff: t2Space_of_section) and for wave 4's equivalence (F(B) is Hausdorff only over Hausdorff B). A naive counterexample (W = {x>0} ⊂ ℝ²−0 modulo diag(2,½)) violates 3°, which is what excludes it.

prose.statement: « si V est supposé para-compact, on peut donc construire une section de V au-dessus de B »
prose.reading: « V para-compact » replaced by B Hausdorff + paracompact (or V second countable + B Hausdorff); the cited general theorem on bundles with contractible fibre is bypassed by a homogeneous norm glued with a partition of unity (plan's route).

kb_proposals: A homogeneous norm N(λm) = λN(m) is a finsum Σ φ_x(p(m))·‖f_x(m)‖ over a partition of unity of the base; the term is continuous on all of V because p⁻¹(tsupport φ_x) ⊆ f_x.source (saturation), and mul_finsum needs no finiteness.
notes: Import: `import BenzecriScaffold.Cone.Section` (imports Cone.Base and Mathlib.Topology.PartitionOfUnity). No ledger label of its own (p. 241 prose); it completes Déf. 3 except for the B-Hausdorff hypothesis. Wave 4/§ 3 hooks: exists_trivialization (V ≃ₜ B × ℝ₊* equivariant), sectionOfNorm.
